CollapseAbilityCards.Name: Collapse ability cards in chat
CollapseAbilityCards.Hint: Collapse the description of ability cards in chat. 'Effects only' keeps the summary (keywords, distance, target) and turns each effect and power roll into a collapsed header you open individually; clicking the ability name opens or closes them all. 'All' hides everything behind the ability name; click the card to expand it. Per client. 'Effects only' has no effect while Compact ability cards is on.
CollapseAbilityCards.Effects: Effects only — keep the summary, collapse each effect
CollapseAbilityCards.All: All — show only the ability name

CompactAbilityCards.Name: Compact ability cards in chat
CompactAbilityCards.Hint: Ability cards show the name with a one-line summary, the effect text without section headers, the tier table folded behind 'tiers' and the roll result on one line (click the total for the dice). Removes Combat Tools' 'automates part of this' note. Per client.

ActivationMode.Name: Combat Tracker dock: Turn Activation
ActivationMode.Hint: How a portrait or group pill in the Draw Steel Combat Tracker dock starts a turn. With Double-click (default), Confirm and Modifier, a plain click only selects and pans to the token(s), so an accidental click no longer starts a turn or rolls a heroic resource.

ShowBeforeStart.Name: Combat Tracker dock: Show Before Combat Starts
ShowBeforeStart.Hint: Show the dock as soon as an encounter exists so you can add tokens, build groups and then press Begin Combat from the dock.

PortraitSize.Name: Combat Tracker dock: Portrait Size
PortraitSize.Hint: Size of the main portraits in pixels (per client). Group pills, minis, names and the dock height scale with it.

Notifications.NoCombatants: Add at least one combatant before beginning the encounter.
Notifications.SelectTokensToAdd: Select one or more tokens to add.

Tracker.Disabled: Stef's Quality of Life Improvements for Draw Steel — Fix 6 is disabled: Combat Tracker {version} is not a verified version ({verified}). The dock runs stock until the port is re-checked.
Tracker.SetupHint: Click to select; the Director starts the encounter
Tracker.WaitingForDirector: Waiting for the Director to begin…
Tracker.ActDouble: Double-click to Act — click to select
Tracker.ActModifier: Ctrl/Shift+Click to Act — click to select

ConfirmActivation.Title: Start Turn?
ConfirmActivation.Content: Start {name}'s turn now? Heroes roll their heroic resource when their turn starts.

Tracker.UndoDone: Activation undone for {name}: initiative, turn and heroic resource restored.
Tracker.NothingToUndo: There is no activation that can be undone.

Version.Unverified: Stef's Quality of Life Improvements for Draw Steel was checked against Combat Tools {verified}, not {version}. Its Combat Tools fixes (ghost art, teleports, squad labels, hidden tokens) still run; check them before a session.

Settings.Name: Movable Hero Tokens / Malice box
Settings.Hint: Show Hero Tokens and Malice in a small box you can drag anywhere on screen (its position is saved per user). Replaces the strip under the players list. The Director clicks a number to remove one and right-clicks to add one; players click Hero Tokens to spend one. Per client.

Tooltip.HeroTokensGM: Click: −1 Hero Token · Right-click: +1 Hero Token
Tooltip.HeroTokensPlayer: Click to spend a hero token
Tooltip.MaliceIdle: No combat: Malice is set when combat starts. Click: −1 · Right-click: +1

MetaBox.SpendConfirm: Spend one hero token? The Director is told in chat.

Trackers.Reveal: Hidden from players: click to reveal
Trackers.Hide: Shown to players: click to hide
Trackers.NoGM: No Director is connected to record this.
Trackers.NoRules: The rules page was not found in the Draw Steel journals.

Montage.Title: Montage test
Montage.DifficultyHint: Montage difficulty: success / failure limits for the hero count
Montage.HeroCountHint: Hero count for the limits (empty: the heroes in the list)
Montage.NextRound: Next round (every hero may act again)
Montage.AwardConfirm: Give {victories} to each of the {heroes} heroes in the montage?
Montage.UsedSkill: Skill already used in this montage
Montage.EndConfirm: End the montage test? It closes for everyone and its tracker is cleared.
Montage.NoTier: The test result could not be read; adjust the montage by hand.

Settings.Name: Montage test tracker
Settings.Hint: Adds a montage test button to the Token controls. The Director starts a montage and its window opens on every screen: success and failure limits, rounds, heroes and their tests, outcome and Victories. Players roll tests for their own heroes from it and can reopen the window with the same button.

Negotiation.Title: Negotiation
Negotiation.Nothing: The Director has not revealed anything yet.
Negotiation.DropHint: Drop an NPC here to load its negotiation stats
Negotiation.EndConfirm: End the negotiation? It closes for everyone and its tracker is cleared.

Settings.Name: Negotiation tracker
Settings.Hint: Adds a negotiation button to the Token controls. The Director starts a negotiation and its window opens on every screen with interest, patience, impression, motivations and pitfalls; drop an NPC on it to load its stats. Players see only what the Director reveals and can reopen the window with the same button.

Colors.Name: Player colors on chat cards
Colors.Hint: Chat cards get a border, and the speaker name a color, in the color of the speaker's player: the player whose character it is or who owns it; NPC and monster cards use the color of the Director who posted them. Per client.

Portraits.Name: Token portraits on chat cards
Portraits.Hint: Show the speaking token's image left of the speaker name on chat cards (ring art for ring tokens). Click it to pan to the token. Per client.
